body.name: ten-point channel candidate map
body.construction: \(C_{\theta}\) is obtained by retaining feasible points from: every vertex of \(D\); every intersection of an axis-aligned edge of \(D\) with \(u+v=q_0+q_1+\sqrt{\theta}|q_1-q_0|\) or \(u+v=q_0+q_1-\sqrt{\theta}|q_1-q_0|\); and, on the edge \(v-u=\kappa\), the point satisfying \(u+v=q_0+q_1\). Duplicate points are removed.
